scope: Real GitHub effects on one owned HTML fixture, forced API process exits, a killed worker and a real loopback socket drop after PR acceptance.

publication.scope: Owned-fixture recovery bench, disposable API worker, safety tests, runbook and this evidence. No production corrector code changed in this phase.

live_fixture.positive_control: Main still has no title; exactly one closing head tag permits the deterministic test patch.

live_scenarios.name: paid_preview_survives_process_exit
live_scenarios.fault: Worker calls os._exit(23) after preview and atomic quota transaction, before recording/returning a completed response.
live_scenarios.result: A new API process returns the saved preview with recovered/cached flags; one model stub invocation and one synthetic usage event overall.

live_scenarios.name: killed_branch_worker_reconciled_without_rebilling
live_scenarios.fault: Relay observes GitHub HTTP 201 for branch creation and holds acknowledgement; the parent kills the API subprocess.
live_scenarios.result: A new process acquires the released payer lock but refuses replay with 503. Operator inspection verifies the unchanged branch against GitHub and explicitly releases the unpaid confirmation receipt.

live_scenarios.name: socket_drop_after_github_pr_acceptance_recovered_once
live_scenarios.fault: Relay observes GitHub HTTP 201 for the draft PR, then shuts down the client TCP socket without delivering its response.
live_scenarios.result: The API returns 400 and has PR intent without a PR receipt. A new process finds/reuses PR 44, restores the task and exact commit verification trace, without another write or debit. Subsequent duplicate request returns 409.

workflow_observations.recovery_transport_calls: GET only; PR identity verified using the existing frozen intent.
workflow_observations.independent_pr_and_main_recheck: Closed, unmerged, still draft, expected head SHA and unchanged fixture main confirmed in another process.
workflow_observations.final_cleanup_identity_hardening_recheck: Final cleanup code re-read PR 44, verified its head/base/repository identity and observed it already closed; no additional PR or closure write.

bench_contract.write_budget: At most two fixture correction branches from the captured main, one exact file patch, one draft PR. No merge, main update, other-file write or branch deletion is accepted by the relay.
bench_contract.database: Fresh SQLite bench.db in the requested empty workdir; inherited production database URL is replaced before backend import.
bench_contract.identity: Synthetic, verified-email account, real session and CSRF middleware; fixture-only plan/connection helpers.
bench_contract.provider: Deterministic stub; not a test of Claude output or SEO repair quality.
bench_contract.startup: API subprocesses exercise routes without production lifespan or scheduler startup.
bench_contract.cleanup: Recheck PR identity before closing only the bench PR; unknown acceptance, absent/ambiguous lookup, identity mismatch and failed closure are not reported as successful cleanup.
bench_contract.validation: Runtime checks remain active under optimized Python; bounded HTTP waits, child termination and relay shutdown precede cleanup.

full_final_local_suite.skip_note: PostgreSQL-only cases were exercised in the preceding 166-pass run; the SQLite instance of PostgreSQL lease termination is inapplicable.

targeted_final_bench_and_reconciliation.includes: Socket faults and real child processes against a fake GitHub upstream, hard write budgets, cleanup identity/ambiguity, existing live-cycle controls and operator reconciliation.

verification.bandit_low_reviewed: Two subprocess warnings: fixed Python executable and worker file, argument list without shell; user workdir is checked for isolation.

harness_isolation_corrections.initial_local_failures: Production startup settings rejected the fixture session secret; then the unverified synthetic email was correctly refused by authentication middleware.
harness_isolation_corrections.fix: Do not execute production lifespan/schedulers in the disposable API harness; mark only its synthetic account verified using the existing helper. No auth bypass or production behavior change.

limitations: Faults are intentionally induced by a loopback relay; this is not an actual GitHub service outage.
Live GitHub effects used SQLite; real PostgreSQL leases/concurrent billing were tested separately, not in this live cycle.
Only single-file confirmation was exercised live; multi-file/billable batches and interruption after an accepted content write need further real-effect controls.
The benchmark does not exercise real service startup, scheduler recovery, production capacity or client deployment.
No additional Claude-written anomaly family, build or SEO recrawl was certified in this phase.
remaining_release_checks: Complete remaining Claude-written anomaly families and indexability-sensitive positive controls.
Exercise billable batch recovery and partial content writes with real GitHub effects and isolated PostgreSQL together.
Validate production startup/schedulers, pooling capacity and receipt retention.
Validate real onboarding and billing lifecycle, then review/deploy and supervise pilots.
